consent_redaction.name: consent_redaction
consent_redaction.value: ("contact_consents"."redacted_at" is null and "contact_consents"."contact_id" is not null and "contact_consents"."channel" is not null and "contact_consents"."source" is not null and "contact_consents"."evidence" is not null) or ("contact_consents"."redacted_at" is not null and "contact_consents"."channel" is null and "contact_consents"."source" is null and "contact_consents"."evidence" is null and "contact_consents"."recorded_by" is null)

identifier_value_length.name: identifier_value_length
identifier_value_length.value: length("contact_identifiers"."value") between 1 and 254 and length("contact_identifiers"."normalized_value") between 1 and 254

crm_field_relation_target.name: crm_field_relation_target
crm_field_relation_target.value: ("crm_field_definitions"."type" = 'relation') = ("crm_field_definitions"."relation_target" is not null) and ("crm_field_definitions"."relation_target" is null or "crm_field_definitions"."relation_target" in ('person', 'company'))

crm_value_record.name: crm_value_record
crm_value_record.value: ("crm_field_values"."object_type" = 'person' and "crm_field_values"."contact_id" is not null and "crm_field_values"."company_id" is null) or ("crm_field_values"."object_type" = 'company' and "crm_field_values"."company_id" is not null and "crm_field_values"."contact_id" is null)

crm_value_text_length.name: crm_value_text_length
crm_value_text_length.value: "crm_field_values"."value_text" is null or length("crm_field_values"."value_text") between 1 and 500

webhooks_fields.name: webhooks_fields
webhooks_fields.value: length("external_webhook_events"."connection_id") between 1 and 100 and length("external_webhook_events"."provider_event_id") between 1 and 100 and length("external_webhook_events"."resource_id") between 1 and 100 and octet_length("external_webhook_events"."raw_body") <= 65536

jobs_lock.name: jobs_lock
jobs_lock.value: ("jobs"."status" = 'running' and "jobs"."locked_at" is not null and "jobs"."locked_by" is not null and "jobs"."lock_token" is not null) or ("jobs"."status" <> 'running' and "jobs"."locked_at" is null and "jobs"."locked_by" is null and "jobs"."lock_token" is null)

jobs_key.name: jobs_key
jobs_key.value: length("jobs"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 200 and length("jobs"."kind") between 1 and 100

opportunity_closed_reason.name: opportunity_closed_reason
opportunity_closed_reason.value: "opportunities"."closed_reason" is null or length("opportunities"."closed_reason") between 1 and 500

outbox_key.name: outbox_key
outbox_key.value: length("outbox_events"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 190 and length("outbox_events"."kind") between 1 and 100
